nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Good morning, Priya. You look tired.
I am! I get up at five o'clock every day.
I go swimming before work. I swim three times a week, on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays. On the other days, I go running.
Wow. I never exercise in the morning. I usually get up at half past seven, and I always have a big breakfast.
Yes, I play tennis with my brother once a week, on Saturdays. But I don't like running. I hate it!
And what do you do after work?
I often cook dinner and watch TV. What about you?
I rarely watch TV. I usually read, and I go to bed at half past nine.
Well, I get up at five!
